title: ComputationKey
description: What a node would compute (docs/design/m0/13 "Model" [G1]). key = H(kind, definition_version, params digest, ordered resolved input ids, generation), computed by internal/graph (G2). A resolved input id is a result id, or for an answer input the approval id and the owed input's revision. A key names a computation, never an output: a result has its own id and answers exactly one key, and each key has one selected result at a time.

generation.description: Starts at 1 and is bumped only by an explicit, recorded invalidation (an operator action, or a definition or instrument version change). A bump changes the key, so a new result is produced and dependants re-key; no result is ever overwritten.
